AR104
Greece: Minotaur to Alexander
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
An introduction to the cultural heritage of ancient Greece, from the palaces of the Minoans to the empire of Alexander the Great. This
course
will examine Archaeological remains, artistic achievements, education, literature, technology, philosophy and politics.
